text:
Selena (PM): ok putting together a proposed scope split for Optimize toolkit — want quick alignment before we lock the sprint
Selena (PM): top-line: MVP = batching recommendations + basic prefix caching hints; Phase 2 = quantization guidance + eval-triggered alerts
Arjun (Eng): curious why batching first? customers keep asking for cost wins but some of them care more about p99 latency
Selena (PM): batching is lower lift to ship as read-only guidance and a few heuristics; caching needs runtime hooks but we can ship hints first
Ken (CS): customer asks: ACME wants quant recs for smaller models asap — they said it reduces infra spend 20% in trials
Marta (SRE): tradeoff: quant recs require model validation infra and perf regressions monitoring. that's a nontrivial ops burden
Arjun (Eng): agree. if we do quant in phase 2 we should include an automated eval-run that checks perplexity + response-stability for a small test set
Selena (PM): proposal: MVP acceptance = docs + UI: 3 batching patterns, 2 cache hint types, runbook for integration. Metrics to pass: no >5% p95 latency regressions across pilot apps, cost improvement signals available in console
Selena (PM): Phase 2 acceptance = quant recs + eval hooks + alerting: canary quant profile + eval suite, alert threshold config
Ken (CS): can we list required customer-facing artifacts? customers want: example configs, quickstart, and a compatibility matrix
Arjun (Eng): yep — add an "inference-safety" checklist. also include a fallback policy suggestion for quant fallbacks
Marta (SRE): for eval-triggered alerts we need clarity on signal definitions. propose: 
Marta (SRE): - primary signal = eval delta on held prompt set (rolling 24h)
Marta (SRE): - secondary = latency p95 spike correlated with batch size changes
Marta (SRE): - tertiary = token-output divergence (BLEU-like) >X over Y samples
Ken (CS): customers will want thresholds editable per-tenant. make them conservative by default
Selena (PM): rollout plan sketch: alpha with 3 pilot customers (ACME, EduTech, FinApps) for MVP, gated by pilot acceptance tests
Selena (PM): gating checklist snippet: 
Selena (PM): ```
Selena (PM): pilot_acceptance: true
Selena (PM): p95_latency_regression < 5%
Selena (PM): quant_eval_stability >= 0.95  # only for phase2
Selena (PM): docs_complete: true
Selena (PM): ```
Arjun (Eng): notes: we should instrument per-route token cost delta so CS can show numbers in demos
Ken (CS): +1. also need canned slides with before/after token-cost numbers for pilot handoffs
Marta (SRE): ops ask: include an escape hatch in rollout-bot for automatic rollback if p99 latency > threshold for 5m
rollout-bot: scheduled rollback hook created: /rollout rollback_on_p99=500ms window=300s
Selena (PM): next steps: Arjun to produce MVP tech spec by EOD Thu, Marta to draft eval signals doc, Ken to confirm 3 pilot customers and their contact windows
Arjun (Eng): working on spec — will include config shapes, sample heuristics and toleration defaults
Marta (SRE): will post eval doc in #eng-sre and link here when ready
Ken (CS): I'll ping ACME + EduTech this afternoon and update the thread
Selena (PM): thanks team. if no objections I'll mark this scope and ship the MVP workstream to the sprint board tomorrow morning :thumbsup:
